rubrics.justification: Accurately reflects a Day-5 4AB hatching blastocyst with appropriate comments on expansion, ICM, TE, and zona status, though some image-specific details are slightly overinterpreted (e.g., exact positioning, nuclear/cytoplasmic features, 'natural zona breaching').
Strong integration of age, tubal factor diagnosis, ovarian response, sperm quality, BMI/lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and well-structured, with probability estimates broadly consistent with the case, but a few claims are overstated or weakly supported (e.g., hatching conferring a clear advantage, lifestyle/FSH linked to embryo mitochondrial function, 'first-cycle advantage').

Mostly aligned in supporting single embryo transfer and generally evidence-based counseling, but includes some nonstandard or weakly supported recommendations such as optional aspirin, ERA after second failure, and unusual luteal support wording (17-OH progesterone caproate).
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer, luteal support, embryo freezing, and contingency planning, though some suggestions are more speculative than guideline-driven.
